title: Continuous integration: building and publishing the image on every commit

videos.script: Every check in this course so far was typed by Ana. This lesson makes a machine type them, on every commit. {{script}} The pipeline is one script: unit tests, integration tests, a scan, then a build and a push. Its first run stopped at the scan, on the finding from lesson twenty. After the fix, it pushed. {{workflow}} Then the GitHub workflow that calls it: a pinned checkout, a token that lives as long as the job, and nothing else. {{release}} And a release. A version tag becomes three image tags, the cache comes from the registry, and one tag holds images for two processor architectures.
